Rice is a field crop unlocked at experience level 56.

It is used to make many products and they mostly require large quantities of rice.

Like all crops, they are stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 270 coin.

Growing rice

Rice is grown in fields by planting another rice plant (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 3 experience points, and takes 45 minutes to mature.

Selling rice

  • Rice can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 180 coin for 10 units.

Using rice

Rice is used to make the following products:


Sushi Roll Lobster Sushi Egg Sushi

x5 x3 x5

Rice Ball
x20
Level 110

Boat orders

  • Boat orders ask for 19 to 32 units of rice per crate, up to a total of 128 per boat.
  • Each unit of rice gives players 7 coins and 5 experience points in boat orders.

Strategy tips

  • Rice can very occasionally be found in the Daily Dirt. Selling it at a lower price is not recommended
  • Recipes ask for three to twenty units of rice. You may want to make sure you always have enough rice in your silo.
See also
